shots.caption: Third person: roof and front cut away
shots.pre: T.clearZombies && T.clearZombies(); const L = T.radioCuesDbg().locker; if (!L || !L.insideAt) throw new Error('vault not built'); const p = L.insideAt; T.setViewFirstDbg(false); T.player.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.05, p.z); await wait(700); T.player.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.05, p.z);

shots.caption: First person: the room stays
shots.pre: const L = T.radioCuesDbg().locker; const p = L.insideAt; T.setViewFirstDbg(true); const t0 = Date.now(); while (T.fpDbg().w < 0.9 && Date.now() - t0 < 8000) { T.player.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.05, p.z); await wait(200); } if (T.fpDbg().w < 0.9) throw new Error('not in first person ' + T.fpDbg().w); if (L.cutaway) throw new Error('still cut away in first person'); T.setOtsAimDbg(null, 0.45); T.player.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.05, p.z); await wait(300);
